mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.tenant_id, s.owner_user_id, s.scope, s.builtin, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted_at, r.revision AS skill_revision, r.version AS skill_version, r.skill_md, r.content_checksum, CASE WHEN #{includeDraft} = 1 AND s.draft_revision IS NOT NULL THEN 'draft' ELSE 'published' END AS effective_state FROM ds_agent_skill s JOIN ds_skill_revision r ON r.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND r.skill_id = s.id AND r.revision = CASE WHEN #{includeDraft} = 1 AND s.draft_revision IS NOT NULL THEN s.draft_revision ELSE s.published_revision END WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.scope = 'global' OR s.owner_user_id = #{userId}) AND (#{includeDraft} = 1 OR s.published_revision IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id, s.tenant_id, s.owner_user_id, s.scope, s.builtin, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted_at, r.revision AS skill_revision, r.version AS skill_version, r.skill_md, r.content_checksum, CASE WHEN #{includeDraft} = 1 AND s.draft_revision IS NOT NULL THEN 'draft' ELSE 'published' END AS effective_state FROM ds_agent_skill s JOIN ds_skill_revision r ON r.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND r.skill_id = s.id AND r.revision = CASE WHEN #{includeDraft} = 1 AND s.draft_revision IS NOT NULL THEN s.draft_revision ELSE s.published_revision END WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.scope = 'global' OR s.owner_user_id = #{userId}) AND (#{includeDraft} = 1 OR s.published_revision IS NOT NULL)

SELECT s.id, s.tenant_id, s.owner_user_id, s.scope, s.builtin, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted_at, r.revision AS skill_revision, r.version AS skill_version, r.skill_md, r.content_checksum, 'pinned' AS effective_state FROM ds_agent_skill s JOIN ds_skill_revision r ON r.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND r.skill_id = s.id AND r.revision = #{skillRevision} WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.id = #{id} AND (s.scope = 'global' OR s.owner_user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_agent_skill (id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, content, state, scope, version, bundle_checksum, builtin, revision, published_revision, draft_revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{content}, #{state}, #{scope}, #{version}, #{bundleChecksum}, #{builtin}, #{revision}, #{publishedRevision}, #{draftRevision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ds_agent_skill SET content = #{entity.content}, state = #{entity.state}, scope = #{entity.scope}, version = #{entity.version}, bundle_checksum = #{entity.bundleChecksum}, builtin = #{entity.builtin}, revision = #{entity.revision}, published_revision = CASE WHEN #{published} = 1 THEN #{entity.revision} ELSE published_revision END, draft_revision = CASE WHEN #{published} = 1 THEN NULL ELSE #{entity.revision} END, updated_at = #{entity.updatedAt}, deleted_at = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{entity.tenantId} AND id = #{entity.id} AND owner_user_id = #{entity.ownerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_skill_revision (tenant_id, skill_id, revision, version, name, description, summary, skill_md, metadata_json, required_tools_json, content_checksum, review_status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{skillId}, #{revision}, #{version}, #{name}, #{description}, #{summary}, #{skillMd}, #{metadataJson}, #{requiredToolsJson}, #{contentChecksum}, #{reviewStatus}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO ds_skill_resource (tenant_id, skill_id, skill_revision, resource_path, media_type, content, size_bytes, checksum) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{skillId}, #{skillRevision}, #{resourcePath}, #{mediaType}, #{content}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksum})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ds_agent_skill_resource WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND skill_id = #{skillId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_agent_skill_resource (tenant_id, skill_id, resource_path, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{skillId}, #{resourcePath}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, skill_id, resource_path, content FROM ds_skill_resource WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND skill_id = #{skillId} AND skill_revision = #{skillRevision} ORDER BY resource_path
